online.profesorTexto: A Costa Rican living in Switzerland. He teaches the Spanish actually spoken in Costa Rica: the voseo, the slang and the tone, not just textbook grammar.

hero.subtitulo: Face to face, no screen in between. The Spanish of the corner shop and the bus stop — the one no textbook teaches you.
hero.fotoAlt: A steep street in San José, houses painted in bright colours and power lines crossing from side to side

presencial.intro: Face to face you learn differently, and faster.
presencial.texto: A lesson is not a questionnaire: it is a conversation. In person you get the gesture, the tone and the interruptions — three things a video call trims away and that in a real language weigh as much as the words. You are corrected on the spot, the moment you say something, not at the end of the hour.
